entities.summary: Olga Botner is a professor of experimental particle physics at Uppsala University known for her work on neutrinos. She is an elected member of the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences. From 2013 until 2017 she was the spokesperson for the IceCube Neutrino Observatory.
